qualification: Pre-fix trun.data_offset resolution negated signed i32 inside i32 (-shift), panicking with 'attempt to negate with overflow' at src/container/mp4.rs:1718:60 on both corrupt short min-underflow.mp4 and legitimate virtual valid-min (-2147483648 across a 2 GiB free box). Pre-fix baseline passed 3/3 controls and both forced acceptance tests failed specifically at the i32::MIN negation overflow panic.

Converting negative trun.data_offset magnitude via u64::from(shift.unsigned_abs()) before base.checked_sub(...) eliminates the i32::MIN negation overflow while preserving exact signed displacement semantics and checked base underflow refusal.

Corrupt short min-underflow.mp4 now refuses cleanly as Error::Invalid ('MP4 fragment data offset before its base') without panicking. Legitimate virtual valid-min indexes all 3 packets (reading 13,152 actual bytes in 10 calls) and plays all 3 native 16x16 VP9 frames with exact analytic planes/RGB (128/130), 50 Hz clocks (0/20/40 ms, 60 ms duration), 8 public clamped seek targets, rewind, and repeated EOF in 71,149 actual bytes read.
4 focused tests, 58 related MP4/HLS/VP9 integration tests, 17 MP4 unit tests, 27 minimal-configuration (--no-default-features) tests, offline fixture generator unittest, and full player build pass.

ISO/IEC 14496-12:2015, 8.8.8 specifies trun.data_offset as a signed 32-bit integer relative to the fragment base offset. All fixtures are pure synthetic offline VP9/fMP4 plans requiring neither FFmpeg nor network access.
counting: One signed trun.data_offset magnitude overflow fix (FVID-0179). No extra IDs for virtual sparse reader, control cases, or fixture generator.
